RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.PROPERTY: One failover test as proof of disaster recovery
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CLAIM: A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR: Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY: Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE: Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN: Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.MODEL: Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.ASSUMPTIONS: Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY: Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS: Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.COVERAGE: Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Retain the tested claim, narrow a broader one or test a material remaining difference.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Recheck the changed component/path or use existing valid evidence when it settles the question.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: A stateless worker failover does not test a corrupt backup, stale authority or shared control-plane outage.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS: Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: A failover result supports the conditions and faults it actually challenges; it does not by itself establish all disaster recovery paths. Guard: A single test can be sufficient for a narrow deterministic question. Generalization needs a justified fault/profile/configuration relationship, not an arbitrary larger test count.

native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement
native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Failure-count/growth tracking and modern incident metrics.
native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use fewer failures/incidents over time as evidence of improvement.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Provide a simple trend signal.
native_record.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No standalone function is established without exposure, severity, detection/reporting and configuration/profile context.
native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Lower demand; hidden/uncaught incidents; severity reclassification; fewer but larger correlated outages; reporting suppression; changed denominator.
native_record.MECHANISM: Reject raw count; normalise by exposure/profile, stratify consequence and recurrence family, track latent/near-miss evidence and detection changes.
native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Use incident rates only with stable definitions/exposure and as one part of ERM-P024/025/028 evidence.
native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low counts, inspect each failure mechanism and consequence rather than model a trend.
native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Event definition, exposure, detection/reporting consistency, severity, configuration and recurrence families.
native_record.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
native_record.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
native_record.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
native_record.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
native_record.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited signal when denominators and ascertainment are stable.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability/service owner and decision authority.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Goodhart effects; ticket splitting/merging; reporting fear; observation changes; tail hidden by count.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Incident absence is compatible with latent failure, low exposure or weak detection.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Raw counts evolved toward exposure-normalised rates, user impact, recurrence and causal corrective-action evidence.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat count as descriptive; claim improvement only with stable exposure, detection and mechanism/impact evidence.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Incident-count OKR is the ceremony.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Large low-frequency outages show count alone can underrepresent consequence (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-062).
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: With stable exposure/reporting and enough events, rates are valid evidence; raw count remains insufficient.
native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can near misses and latent faults be integrated without incentivising over-reporting games?

current_claim.bearer: Reported incident counts and an improvement claim.
current_claim.proposition: No incidents or fewer reported incidents can be consistent with low exposure, missing detection, changing severity definitions or chance; counts alone do not prove improved reliability.
current_claim.guard_quantifier: Descriptive counts are legitimate when their population and observation window are stated. Rate/causal comparisons require relevant exposure, detection and case-mix information.
current_claim.model_domain: A count is an observation. Risk and intervention effect are different estimands.
current_claim.mechanism: Prevents underreporting or denominator change from becoming apparent engineering success.
current_claim.consumer_decision: Inspect mechanisms, normalize exposure, retain uncertainty or investigate a changed reporting process.
current_claim.positive_scope: Honest count descriptions, low-count case analysis and appropriate statistical comparison.
current_claim.negative_scope: The universal proof inference is rejected; a higher count does not automatically prove worsening either.
current_claim.counterexample: C08dropsfrom10to5failures while exposure drops1000to100, so the observed rate increases fivefold.
current_claim.criterion: Reconcile failure definition, exposure, reporting/ascertainment and concurrent changes before claiming improvement.
current_claim.evidence_ceiling: Historical selected reporting, methodology and invented arithmetic; no real pre/post causal study.
current_claim.remaining_premises: Complete enough observation, comparable opportunities, uncertainty and mechanism evidence.
current_claim.cheap_path_alternatives: For a few cases, inspect each material mechanism/consequence rather than fitting a fragile trend.
current_claim.cost_retirement: Avoid incentives to suppress incidents; stop collecting unused headline counts while retaining useful underlying evidence.
current_claim.audit_question: Could the count change be explained by exposure or observation rather than a real change in failure risk?
current_claim.change_note: Original ceremony rejection retained.

native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Fast local indication within bounded coverage.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Traffic manager/operator; not a generic mission claimant.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False green, false red, cached response, monitor shares failure, healthy component unreachable.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Component alive is not system function; incident evidence is direct.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: One-bit health evolved toward layered symptoms, journeys, state and diagnostic coverage.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A green signal is labelled with exact coverage and never expanded beyond it.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The green checkmark is the ceremony.

native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Run a fault-injection event and conclude the system is resilient.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Challenge integrated failure handling.
native_record.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No general resilience property follows; evidence is bounded to the hypothesis, fault, profile, boundary, observation and recovery postconditions.
native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Toy fault; easy steady-state metric; no state/data validation; unrepresentative load; no correlated failure; no action; survivorship bias.
native_record.MECHANISM: Reject ceremony; apply ERM-P035 hypothesis-bound experiments selected by decision value.
native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Only when a live uncertainty cannot be resolved more cheaply/safely and experiment controls are adequate.
native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Static analysis, simulation, staging or direct functional/recovery test.
native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Hypothesis, coverage, containment, observability, abort, representative state/load and decision consumer.
native_record.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
native_record.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
native_record.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
native_record.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
native_record.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Specific evidence for the tested claim.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Service/mission owner and reliability decision-maker.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Chaos theatre; production harm; impressive demo; repeated schedule; no denominator; no postconditions.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The 2025 multivocal review identifies unresolved evaluation/adoption gaps; principles are advocacy, not independent proof.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Random breakage/“monkey” branding narrowed to controlled, hypothesis-driven, decision-linked experiments.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Never claim general resilience; publish tested claim, boundaries, observations, recovery validation and resulting decision.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The named chaos event is the ceremony.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta’s storm drills aided recovery but did not cover the actual global-backbone scenario (SRC-059).
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Well-designed fault injection is strong demonstration evidence for its tested conditions.
native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should experiment portfolios quantify coverage without recreating a giant failure checklist?

current_claim.proposition: An exercise is evidence for its tested claim, configuration, fault and observations; exercise branding or completion is not general resilience assurance.
current_claim.guard_quantifier: Preserve legitimate confirmations/no-change outcomes. Generalization requires a justified relation to untested conditions and cannot be supplied by exercise frequency alone.
current_claim.model_domain: Finite execution and universal system properties have different quantifiers.
current_claim.mechanism: Prevents a useful local experiment from being promoted to unbounded marketing or governance authority.
current_claim.consumer_decision: Retain/narrow a claim, fix a discovered issue, stop an unsafe experiment or use a cheaper discriminator.

properties.current_name: More redundancy always improves reliability

native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: More redundancy always improves reliability
native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Parallel RBD arithmetic and fault-tolerance intuition.
native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Add copies/paths so independent joint failure becomes less likely.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Reduce random component failure probability.
native_record.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Improved mission outcome after specified faults, not increased component count.
native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.
native_record.MECHANISM: Reject monotonic slogan; apply ERM-P008/009/040 and compare total system reliability/maintainability under dependence and coverage.
native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Add redundancy only when failure modes, domains, coverage, state and lifecycle burden support positive net value.
native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Simplify/eliminate the failure cause, add a manual spare, improve repair, or accept risk when redundancy burden exceeds benefit.
native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Common-cause model, transfer coverage, capacity/state, maintenance/support and evidence.
native_record.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
native_record.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
native_record.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.
native_record.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
native_record.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Can be large under valid independence; can be negative otherwise.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architect and mission/risk authority.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Shared power/control/specification; hidden standby; complexity; simultaneous maintenance; false failover; correlated release.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Formal and empirical literature directly show dependence can destroy the multiplicative benefit.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Copy-count reasoning evolved toward failure-domain, coverage, diversity, state and supportability cases.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The N+1/TMR diagram is the ceremony when assumptions are unstated.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Nominal standby/backup failures and shared-update incidents show added copies do not imply independent service (SRC-060–SRC-062).
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Independent, observable, maintainable redundancy remains one of the strongest reliability mechanisms.
native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should engineering teams quantify negative reliability from operational complexity before deployment?

FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.PROPERTY: More redundancy always improves reliability
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE: Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.LOCAL_EFFECT: Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT: Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.END_EFFECT: Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.PROPAGATION_PATH: Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY: A declared fault-containment region or explicit stop/degradation boundary.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.DEPENDENCIES: Common-cause model, transfer coverage, capacity/state, maintenance/support and evidence.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING: Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.LATENT_CONDITION: Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.DETECTION: Outcome- or function-relevant observation, not a component heartbeat alone.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.CONTROL: Reject monotonic slogan; apply ERM-P008/009/040 and compare total system reliability/maintainability under dependence and coverage.
FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.RESIDUAL_RISK: Unmodelled combinations, dependence, coverage gaps and changed configuration remain.

REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.REDUNDANCY_FORM: Active, standby, voting, diverse, replicated or alternate-path redundancy as explicitly declared.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.CLAIMED_TOLERANCE: The specified number/class of faults tolerated while meeting required function or an accepted degraded state.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.FAILURE_DOMAINS: Physical, power, network, control-plane, state, software, supplier, operator and maintenance domains.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.INDEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE: Evidence must address shared causes rather than infer independence from copy count or labels.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.COMMON_CAUSE_COUPLINGS: Specification, design, implementation, environment, supplier, maintenance, configuration and operational coupling.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.STANDBY_LATENCY_OR_DORMANCY: Dormant faults, activation delay and cold/warm/hot readiness are measured when applicable.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.SWITCHOVER_COVERAGE: Detection, decision, transfer, state synchronisation and post-transfer functional success.
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE.STATE_CONSISTENCY: The takeover state and authority must be current, complete and semantically valid.

current_claim.bearer: An architecture change adding replicas, voters, transfer or synchronization.
current_claim.proposition: Adding redundancy need not improve whole-system reliability because new failure paths, common causes and burdens can outweigh rescue cases.
current_claim.guard_quantifier: Ideal monotone OR addition cannot reduce success when it introduces no interactions or losses. Real additions can violate that guard. Dependence alone does not imply negative benefit.
current_claim.model_domain: Distinguish monotonicity of a fixed mathematical structure from changed-system behavior.
current_claim.mechanism: Compares rescue events with added losses instead of counting copies.
current_claim.consumer_decision: Add, simplify, isolate, improve repair or accept downtime.
current_claim.positive_scope: Legitimate beneficial redundancy, including under dependence, underC009.

native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Predictive maintenance universally outperforms simpler policies
native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Industry 4.0/AI predictive-maintenance promotion.
native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use sensors and ML/RUL prediction to replace scheduled or reactive maintenance.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Reduce unexpected failure and unnecessary scheduled work.
native_record.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Lower mission/lifecycle loss than feasible alternatives under actual failure mechanisms and action constraints.
native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: No precursor; weak labels; domain shift; false alarms; late warning; costly sensor stack; maintenance action itself harmful; benchmark not prospective.
native_record.MECHANISM: Reject universality; use ERM-P023 comparative, uncertainty-aware, mechanism- and decision-valid assessment.
native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Only for observable degradation with lead time and effective intervention.
native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Run-to-failure, inspection or scheduled maintenance when net performance is comparable.
native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Sensors, data, transfer, uncertainty, lead time, intervention efficacy and loss comparison.
native_record.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
native_record.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
native_record.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
native_record.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
native_record.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Potentially high in suitable mechanisms; absent or negative elsewhere.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Asset owner and maintenance planner.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: AI hype; accuracy metric not decision value; false work orders; missed failure; model maintenance burden.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Systematic reviews show heterogeneous evidence; current uncertainty review rejects certainty in RUL deployment.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Universal automation claims narrowed toward hybrid/uncertainty-aware and decision-comparative PHM.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: No “PdM is better” claim without prospective comparison to the cheapest credible policy.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The platform/digital twin/RUL dashboard is ceremony without demonstrated decision payoff.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Current reviews document growth and uncertainty, not universal prospective superiority (SRC-071–SRC-073).
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Specific well-instrumented degradation mechanisms support effective PdM.
native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What proportion of published PdM systems have prospective multi-site net-benefit evidence?

native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: Zero observed failures means zero failure probability or an unlimited reliability claim
native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Success-run and zero-failure reliability demonstrations.
native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Accept a reliability target after a specified number of failure-free trials/hours.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Demonstrate a lower reliability bound when failures are rare.

native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Can provide meaningful lower-bound evidence despite no observed failures.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Acceptance/test authority.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Rule of three misapplied; unit-hours pooled; repeated demands dependent; success selection; no tail information.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Primary statistical sources directly distinguish a minimum bound from zero risk or a life distribution.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Zero-failure pass/fail evolved toward explicit confidence, dependence and censoring treatment.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Publish exact test design and bounded inference; never “zero failures therefore reliable.”
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The zero-failure badge/certificate is the ceremony.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: No incident history can rule out latent or correlated failures absent sufficient representative exposure.
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Large representative independent success runs can strongly bound demand reliability; the unlimited inference is rejected.

native_record.PROPERTY_NAME: AI/ML/agentic diagnosis or auto-remediation as a general reliability property
native_record.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: ML anomaly detection/PHM, AIOps, autonomous repair and rapidly emerging agentic systems.
native_record.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use learned models/agents to detect anomalies, diagnose causes, predict failure and autonomously remediate.
native_record.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Complex systems produce more telemetry and faster events than humans can always interpret or act on.
native_record.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Improve detection/restoration outcomes for a defined function without introducing unacceptable nondeterminism, drift, authority or cascading risk.
native_record.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Distribution drift; uncalibrated confidence; opaque cause; tool/action hallucination; shared model/data dependency; unsafe authority; repeated remediation loop; evidence destruction.
native_record.MECHANISM: Bound use case/action authority; monitor postdeployment drift; expose uncertainty/abstention; require independent functional postconditions; sandbox/canary/reversible actions; human escalation and non-AI fallback.
native_record.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Narrow, observable tasks with representative evaluation, reversible bounded action and independent verification where automation value exceeds risk.
native_record.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Rules, deterministic functional checks, manual diagnosis or conventional automation when they resolve the same task more transparently.
native_record.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Current data/profile, trusted telemetry, calibration, drift detection, action sandbox, configuration/state authority, recovery fallback and governance.
native_record.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
native_record.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
native_record.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
native_record.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
native_record.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
native_record.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
native_record.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Potential speed/scale improvement in bounded diagnostics or remediation; no general field-reliability claim is established.
native_record.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Operator, maintainer, service/mission owner and automation authority.
native_record.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Nondeterminism; brittleness; hidden shared assumptions; out-of-distribution faults; false confidence; prompt/tool injection as boundary; action compounding; accountability gap.
native_record.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: NIST 2024/2026 sources describe assurance, coverage, monitoring and validation methods as active challenges; evidence is nascent and use-case specific.
native_record.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: ML prediction expanded toward deployed monitoring and agents, while assurance shifted toward lifecycle monitoring, uncertainty, authority limits and independent validation.
native_record.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Only a domain-specific assistive/automated mechanism with bounded function, calibrated uncertainty, drift monitoring, reversible authority, independent postconditions and fallback.
native_record.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “AI-powered reliability” branding or an agent demo is not the property; demonstrated bounded net dependability is.
native_record.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Current authoritative sources establish monitoring/assurance challenges; no broad multi-domain evidence establishes autonomous agents as a general reliability improvement.
native_record.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Narrow anomaly detection, prognostics and automated repair can outperform manual/rule baselines in specific validated settings.
native_record.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can agent action reliability, tool/state authority, joint human–automation recovery and rare cascading errors be demonstrated prospectively?

current_claim.bearer: A specified AI/ML/agent-assisted diagnostic or remediation mechanism and its actual action authority.
current_claim.proposition: An AI label adds no general reliability property. A particular model can assist detection, diagnosis or action only to the extent supported for its task, population, errors, resources and permitted consequences.
current_claim.guard_quantifier: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred.
current_claim.model_domain: Benchmark accuracy, model statements and deterministic postconditions are distinct from deployed reliable remediation and organizational authority.
current_claim.mechanism: May supply a useful signal or candidate action; may also misclassify, drift, amplify shared errors or add maintenance burden.

current_claim.counterexample: A high-scoring detector drives unnecessary repairs for rare failures, or an unverified proposed action passes a syntactic check but violates a functional postcondition.
current_claim.criterion: Name the task, actual access/action scope, failure population, comparator, observation and postcondition needed for the claimed result.
current_claim.evidence_ceiling: Qualitative2026NISTworkshops/literature scope and scoped review/abstract, not prospective agent remediation effectiveness or a new general-property proof.

current_claim.cost_retirement: Include model upkeep, data, integration, false actions, review and displaced protection; remove unsupported automation while retaining useful bounded signals.

DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE.RECOVERY_COVERAGE: Count a detected event as successfully restored or contained only for the separately declared action outcome and denominator. A true detected event remains detected even when restoration is absent or unresolved. Detection, isolation, containment and restoration coverage are reported separately.
DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: An AI label adds no general reliability property. A particular model can assist detection, diagnosis or action only to the extent supported for its task, population, errors, resources and permitted consequences. Guard: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred.

RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.PROPERTY: AI/ML/agentic diagnosis or auto-remediation as a general reliability property
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.INITIATING_FAILURE: Distribution drift; uncalibrated confidence; opaque cause; tool/action hallucination; shared model/data dependency; unsafe authority; repeated remediation loop; evidence destruction. Current limitation: No general agentic-resilience claim, inferred human performance transfer or autonomous authority from a benchmark. CrowdStrike Rapid Response Content is not treated as AI merely because it was automated.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.RECOVERY_ACTION: May supply a useful signal or candidate action; may also misclassify, drift, amplify shared errors or add maintenance burden.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.AUTHORITY_SOURCE: State/configuration identity and the actual authority relevant to the action or claim. A pure model has no external action authority; a bounded internal restore does not by itself establish authority to resume a wider service.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.CHECKPOINT_BACKUP_SPARE_OR_ALTERNATE: Declared checkpoint, replica, backup, spare, rebuild source or manual workaround.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.RPO_OR_STATE_LOSS_BOUND: State/data loss bound where the function depends on preserved state; explicitly state a nontrigger for stateless or directly reconstructible functions.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.RTO_OR_RESTORATION_BOUND: The declared restoration interval or bound, if the claim requires one. Distinguish detection, waiting, logistics, repair and validation and avoid summing overlapping intervals.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.STATE_RECONCILIATION: Reconcile the state required by the named restored function. Broader divergent or external state may remain an explicit residual; authoritative wider service requires its own relevant conditions.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.FUNCTIONAL_POSTCONDITIONS: Improve detection/restoration outcomes for a defined function without introducing unacceptable nondeterminism, drift, authority or cascading risk. Current scope: Domain-specific validated assistance, including partial useful information with unresolved diagnosis.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.DATA_STATE_POSTCONDITIONS: Integrity, completeness, freshness, ordering and authority appropriate to the mission.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.DEPENDENCY_POSTCONDITIONS: Verify dependencies that the particular restoration claim requires. Record unverified external dependencies separately; they prevent an unsupported wider completion claim but do not erase a valid internal postcondition.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.VALIDATION: An observation or proof adequate to the named functional/state postcondition. Independent end-to-end checks are appropriate when the claim needs them, not a universal prerequisite for every local deterministic restoration.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.RETURN_TO_SERVICE_AUTHORITY: Keep proof of the postcondition separate from actual permission to resume consequential service. Name the relevant decision maker or rule when applicable.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.ROLLBACK_OR_FALLBACK: A justified bounded fallback where it adds protection. It need not resolve every root cause, and not every restoration claim requires a second full recovery mechanism.
RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: An AI label adds no general reliability property. A particular model can assist detection, diagnosis or action only to the extent supported for its task, population, errors, resources and permitted consequences. Guard: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred.

RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.PROPERTY: AI/ML/agentic diagnosis or auto-remediation as a general reliability property
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CLAIM: An AI label adds no general reliability property. A particular model can assist detection, diagnosis or action only to the extent supported for its task, population, errors, resources and permitted consequences. Guard: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR: Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY: Identify the hardware, software, data, model, environment, dependency and procedure conditions that the particular claim materially depends on. An exhaustive live inventory is not universally required.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE: Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN: Use a design adequate to the estimand: sampling, censoring, exposure and stopping assumptions for stochastic inference; an exact predicate and finite domain for a deterministic check. Retrospective observations retain their actual design limits.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.MODEL: Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.ASSUMPTIONS: Declare the assumptions actually used, such as independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage or representativeness. Their absence from an unrelated deterministic claim is not automatically a defect.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY: Express uncertainty appropriate to the claim. A stochastic estimate needs its model and uncertainty; an exact deterministic result need not invent a probability interval. A qualitative criterion may remain qualitative.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS: Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.COVERAGE: Empirical inference is limited by the observed population and design; a mathematical or exhaustive finite result can cover its explicitly proved domain. Neither automatically supplies external-system correspondence.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Use a bounded assistant, retain deterministic rules/manual diagnosis, run an adequate comparison or decline automation.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Rules, direct functional checks, conventional automation or manual diagnosis can be more transparent and sufficient.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: A high-scoring detector drives unnecessary repairs for rare failures, or an unverified proposed action passes a syntactic check but violates a functional postcondition.
RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS: Reassess evidence when a relevant configuration, profile, environment, support or dependency change alters a premise. No arbitrary periodic expiry or full-retest rule follows for unaffected claims.

Guard: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred.

properties.profile_scope: The native applicability classification is retained for this candidate claim. Applicable templates describe claim-specific questions, not a mandatory bundle for every system. Nonapplicable reasons remain exact.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Historical attribution retained, with current typed genealogy and exact fresh scopes. No original executed-prompt or earliest-priority inference.

FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Benchmark accuracy, model statements and deterministic postconditions are distinct from deployed reliable remediation and organizational authority. Qualitative2026NISTworkshops/literature scope and scoped review/abstract, not prospective agent remediation effectiveness or a new general-property proof.

LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Selected reported operating/experimental evidence, if listed; no new empirical dataset received or reanalyzed. Empty list means no such fresh direct evidence assigned to this claim.

DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Author cases are constructed arithmetic/logical witnesses only. No deployed demonstration or physical/operational test was performed.

INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Listed operator incident accounts support reported mechanisms at those events, not prevalence or independently verified countermeasure effects.

OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: Listed normative/practitioner/owner sources explain selected mechanisms, intent or currentness at their access scopes; they are not independent causal efficacy studies.

REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: No independent replication of the author cases or target field effect. Related source versions, chapters and reports are grouped in the source dependence register.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.current_scope_judgment: No target-system transfer established. Task correspondence, labels, distribution shift, beneficial action, authority, integration, cost and human impact where actually measured.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.current_scope_judgment: Evaluate the underlying function and action separately. Appropriate uncertainty, monitoring, review, reversibility or fallback depends on the actual mechanism; no universal mandatory bundle is inferred. No general agentic-resilience claim, inferred human performance transfer or autonomous authority from a benchmark. CrowdStrike Rapid Response Content is not treated as AI merely because it was automated.
